papers.title: Coral: Cost-Efficient Multi-LLM Serving over Heterogeneous Cloud GPUs
papers.abstract: The usage of large language models (LLMs) has grown increasingly fragmented, with no single model dominating. Meanwhile, cloud providers offer a wide range of mid-tier and older-generation GPUs that enjoy better availability and deliver comparable performance per dollar to top-tier hardware. To efficiently harness these heterogeneous resources for serving multiple LLMs concurrently, we introduce Coral, an adaptive heterogeneity-aware multi-LLM serving system. The key idea behind Coral is to jointly optimize resource allocation and the serving strategy of each model replica across all models. To keep pace with shifting throughput demand and resource availability, Coral applies a lossless two-stage decomposition that preserves joint optimality while cutting online solve time from hours to tens of seconds. Our evaluation across 6 models and 20 GPU configurations shows that Coral reduces serving cost by up to 2.79$\times$ over the best baseline, and delivers up to 2.39$\times$ higher goodput under scarce resource availability.

papers.title: Design Conductor 2.0: An agent builds a TurboQuant inference accelerator in 80 hours
papers.abstract: Driven by a rapid co-evolution of both harness and underlying models, LLM agents are improving at a dizzying pace. In our prior work (performed in Dec. 2025), we introduced "Design Conductor" (or just "Conductor"), a system capable of building a 5-stage Linux-capable RISC-V CPU in 12 hours. In this work, we introduce an updated multi-agent harness powered by frontier models released in April 2026, which is able to handle 80x larger tasks, at higher quality, fully autonomously. Following a brief introduction, we examine 4 designs that the system produced autonomously, including "VerTQ", an LLM inference accelerator which hard-wires support for TurboQuant in a 240-cycle pipeline, starting from the TurboQuant arXiv paper. VerTQ includes heavy compute processing, with 5129 FP16/32 units; the design was mapped to an FPGA at 125 MHz and consumes 5.7 mm^2 in TSMC 16FF (8 attention pipes). We review the key new characteristics that enabled these results. Finally, we analyze Design Conductor's token usage and other empirical characteristics, including its limitations.

papers.title: RangeGuard: Efficient, Bounded Approximate Error Correction for Reliable DNNs
papers.abstract: As DRAM scales in density and adopts 3D integration, raw fault rates increase and multi-bit errors are no longer rare. Such errors can severely impact Deep Neural Networks (DNNs): although DNNs tolerate small numerical perturbations, random bit flips can create extreme outliers that propagate and sharply degrade accuracy. Large Language Models (LLMs) are particularly vulnerable because attention, residual, and normalization layers can amplify and preserve a single corrupted activation across many layers, destabilizing inference. This paper introduces RangeGuard, a metadata-centric error-correcting framework that provides strong reliability and high efficiency based on bounded approximate correction. Instead of protecting raw bits, RangeGuard encodes compact Range Identifiers (RIDs) that capture the numerical range of each value. These compact metadata enable efficient use of limited redundancy and concentrate protection on range changes, which indicate harmful semantic deviations, while ignoring benign intra-range variations. Upon detecting a range change, RangeGuard restores the correct range and substitutes a representative value, ensuring that error magnitudes are bounded within the range. Based on RIDs, RangeGuard can tolerate 64+ flipped bits using only 16 bits of parity available in GPU memories without a noticeable accuracy loss. By introducing semantic range protection, RangeGuard enables reliable DNN execution even under frequent memory errors and tight redundancy budgets.

papers.title: KernelBench-X: A Comprehensive Benchmark for Evaluating LLM-Generated GPU Kernels
papers.abstract: LLM-based Triton kernel generation has attracted significant interest, yet a fundamental empirical question remains unanswered: where does this capability break down, and why? We present KernelBench-X, a benchmark designed to answer this question through category-aware evaluation of correctness and hardware efficiency across 176 tasks in 15 categories. Our systematic comparison of five representative methods yields three main findings. First, task structure determines correctness more than method design. Category explains nearly three times more variance in semantic correctness than method (9.4% vs 3.3% explained deviance), and 72% of Fusion tasks fail across all five methods while Math tasks are solved consistently. Second, iterative refinement improves correctness, but not performance. Across GEAK iterations, compile rate rises from 52.3% to 68.8% while average speedup declines from $1.58\times$ to $1.44\times$; newly rescued kernels consistently underperform persistently correct ones ($1.16\times$ vs $1.58\times$ speedup in round~0$\to$1). Third, correctness does not imply efficiency. 46.6% of correct kernels are slower than the PyTorch eager baseline, and cross-hardware speedup variance reaches $21.4\times$. Besides, quantization remains completely unsolved (0/30 successes) despite non-trivial compilation rates, revealing systematic misunderstanding of numerical computation contracts rather than surface-level syntax errors. These findings suggest that future progress depends on handling global coordination, explicitly modeling numerical precision, and incorporating hardware efficiency into generation. The code is available at https://github.com/BonnieW05/KernelBenchX

papers.title: AxMoE: Characterizing the Impact of Approximate Multipliers on Mixture-of-Experts DNN Architectures
papers.abstract: Deep neural network (DNN) inference at the edge demands simultaneous improvements in accuracy, computational efficiency, and energy consumption. Approximate computing and Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) architectures have each been studied as independent routes towards efficient inference, the former by replacing exact arithmetic with low-power approximate multipliers, the latter by routing inputs through specialized expert sub-networks to enable conditional computation. However, their interaction remains entirely unexplored. This paper presents AxMoE, the first study of the impact of approximate multiplication on MoE DNN architectures. We evaluate three MoE variants: Hard MoE, Soft MoE, and Cluster MoE against dense baselines across three CNN architectures (ResNet-20, VGG11_bn, VGG19_bn) on CIFAR-100 and a Vision Transformer (ViT-Small) on Tiny ImageNet-200 dataset, using eight 8-bit signed multipliers (including one exact baseline) from the EvoApproxLib library. Results show that, without retraining, the Dense baseline is the most resilient topology across all CNN architectures, whereas on ViT-Small, all topologies degrade at comparable rates regardless of routing strategy. After approximate-aware retraining, recovery varies substantially across architectures, topologies, and multipliers. ResNet-20 achieves full recovery across the entire multiplier range, whereas VGG architectures recover at moderate multipliers but fail irreversibly at aggressive ones for all topologies except Cluster MoE on VGG11_bn; on ViT-Small, Hard MoE outperforms Dense under aggressive approximation at equal normalized inference cost. These results pave the way for future approximate MoE hardware-software co-design strategies.

digest.motivationZh: 问题是Transformer类大规模深度网络推理中MMMO使数据搬移开销超过计算开销。重要性在于嵌入式/边缘场景受延迟、带宽和资源利用约束，单纯DRAM内计算不一定高效。已有Newton、TransPIM等AIMA未区分Transformer层间并行度和资源需求差异，导致轻量MMMO在DRAM-AIMA上资源低利用、推理延迟升高。该问题直接对应用户关注的PIM、存储层次和Transformer加速器架构。
digest.methodZh: 这是硬件/体系结构与数据流协同设计。核心是HAIMA混合SRAM与DRAM accelerator-in-memory架构，把不同类型的Transformer矩阵-矩阵乘法映射到更合适的SRAM-AIM或DRAM-AIM，并用并行数据流组织执行。可读摘要未披露具体层级划分规则、阵列规模、数据布局和调度细节，因此方法新意可确认的是异构AIM协同而非单一DRAM PIM。

digest.summaryZh: DRViT是面向Vision Transformer边缘推理的算法-架构协同FPGA加速器。它用动态token merging、token pruning和INT8量化削减冗余计算，并设计专用模块承接不规则模式；在Alveo U250上ViT-tiny达到0.86ms/image和1380GOP/s峰值。
digest.motivationZh: 问题是ViT在多模态/边缘场景中计算和存储需求高，尤其MHSA的Q/K/V在线生成、高维多头张量、LayerNorm/Softmax/GELU等非线性浮点操作以及低数据复用带来高延迟和能耗。已有轻量化算法会产生动态不规则token模式，若架构不能感知冗余和调度不规则性，就难以把算法收益变成硬件吞吐和能效。该问题与用户关注的Transformer/NPU加速、硬件友好量化和软硬件协同相关。
digest.methodZh: 这是算法-架构协同的FPGA系统。算法侧用动态token merging、token pruning和INT8量化减少ViT冗余计算与浮点非线性；架构侧设计动态冗余感知的专用数据流和模块，包括Token Merging and Pruning Module、Integer-Only Nonlinear Function Module、SLR Management Module等，将不规则token处理转化为可流式执行的硬件流程。新意在于同时处理token动态稀疏和整数化非线性，而不是只做静态量化或矩阵阵列。
digest.experimentsZh: 实现于Xilinx Alveo U250，使用Vivado 2020.1/2022.1，运行ViT-tiny/ImageNet并与CPU、GPU及其他FPGA加速器比较。报告140MHz下0.86ms/image、100MHz下1.17ms/image，峰值吞吐1380GOP/s，较以往SOTA提升2.24×。预览未完整披露所有baseline名称、准确率损失和能耗具体数值。
digest.affiliationsZh: 未在DBLP/arXiv元数据中提供；ScienceDirect预览显示作者有a/b上标但未展开机构名称，无法可靠写出全体作者单位。
digest.researchFitZh: 属于硬件体系结构主线，但模型是ViT而非LLM；对动态token稀疏、整数非线性和FPGA数据流设计有参考价值。
digest.whyReadZh: 值得继续读，重点看动态token合并/剪枝如何在硬件中避免控制和访存开销，以及Integer-Only Nonlinear模块的实现。
digest.limitationsZh: 本地无PDF；ScienceDirect预览只给摘要和节选，未完整披露baseline表、准确率变化、能耗细节和所有模块实现参数。

motivationDetail.problemZh: ViT在边缘/分布式多模态任务中计算、存储和非线性浮点开销高。
motivationDetail.gapZh: 轻量化token算法会引入不规则计算模式，通用CPU/GPU或普通FPGA映射难以高效利用。
motivationDetail.whyImportantZh: 边缘多模态应用要求低延迟、高能效和本地处理，云端部署不能满足实时与安全要求。

papers.title: Pimba: A Processing-in-Memory Acceleration for Post-Transformer Large Language Model Serving
papers.matchedQuery: processing in memory transformer
matchedQueries: processing in memory transformer

digest.summaryZh: Pimba面向Mamba-2、线性注意力、RNN等post-transformer LLM与传统Transformer的统一服务瓶颈，提出GPU+PIM加速方案。其SPU跨两个bank共享，SPE采用MX8量化算术执行状态更新和注意力，报告相对GPU/GPU+PIM提升生成吞吐并降低能耗。
digest.motivationZh: 问题是长上下文LLM服务中Transformer注意力和post-transformer状态更新都会在batch推理下受内存带宽限制。重要性在于SSM、linear attention、RNN等新模型被用于降低长序列成本，但服务系统需要同时支持新旧模型。已有PIM多聚焦attention/GEMV；post-transformer状态更新包含逐元素乘加、点积等多种原语，逐bank PIM面积成本高，且低精度格式会影响持续状态更新准确性。该问题正中用户关注的LLM推理系统、PIM、KV/状态存储和硬件友好量化。
digest.methodZh: 这是PIM体系结构、低精度算术和GPU-PIM系统协同设计。Pimba将状态更新与attention offload到PIM，其他操作交给GPU；核心硬件是每两个bank共享一个State-update Processing Unit，内部SPE含MX8量化的向量乘法器和加法器，用交错访问读写不同bank的row buffer。系统还包含自定义DRAM命令与调度，支持状态预充和生成期计算。新意在于把post-transformer状态更新作为一等公民，而非只优化Transformer attention。
digest.experimentsZh: 评估覆盖Mamba-2、GLA、RetNet、HGRN2、Zamba2和OPT，比较GPU、GPU+Q、GPU+PIM、NeuPIMs/HBM-PIM等，指标包括生成吞吐、状态更新/attention延迟、能耗、准确率和面积。可读全文报告状态更新延迟较GPU/GPU+PIM低14.6×/6.9×，attention低6.3×/1.8×，能耗平均较GPU/GPU+PIM低2.2×/1.2×，面积开销13.4%。吞吐结果网页摘要与全文存在3.2×/4.1×相对GPU的不一致，但均报告相对GPU+PIM最高2.1×。
digest.affiliationsZh: 全文首页显示Wonung Kim、Yubin Lee、Yoonsung Kim、Jinwoo Hwang、Seongryong Oh、Jiyong Jung、Aziz Huseynov、Woong Gyu Park、Jongse Park为KAIST；Chang Hyun Park为Uppsala University；Divya Mahajan为Georgia Institute of Technology。
digest.researchFitZh: 非常贴合用户主线：它同时涉及LLM推理服务、PIM近存计算、post-transformer架构、低精度算术和GPU-PIM系统边界。
digest.whyReadZh: 应深读，尤其关注状态更新roofline、SPU跨bank共享的面积/吞吐权衡、MX8对连续状态更新准确率的影响，以及与attention PIM系统的兼容方式。
digest.limitationsZh: 可读来源中预印本/网页摘要对相对GPU吞吐上限有3.2×与4.1×差异，需核对最终ACM版本；部分模型规模、完整硬件参数和准确率表需读论文全文确认。

motivationDetail.problemZh: post-transformer LLM和Transformer在batched generation下都受内存带宽限制，尤其状态更新成为低算术强度瓶颈。
motivationDetail.gapZh: 既有LLM PIM系统主要针对attention/GEMV，不能高效支持状态更新；逐bank实现状态更新硬件面积过高。
motivationDetail.whyImportantZh: 长上下文、RAG、多模态输入推动序列长度增长，服务成本和GPU内存/带宽压力显著上升。
motivationDetail.userRelevanceZh: 直接对应LLM推理系统、PIM、状态/KV存储层次和硬件友好量化。
motivationDetail.evidence: ResearchGate full text; KAIST Pure metadata; GitHub README

methodDetail.coreIdeaZh: 用GPU+PIM统一服务Transformer和post-transformer，把attention与状态更新放到PIM中并用MX8降低数据搬移和面积。
methodDetail.hardwareSystemDetailZh: SPU交错访问两个bank的row buffer以维持吞吐并控制面积；PIM执行状态更新和attention，GPU处理其他层；使用MX8量化和随机舍入缓解连续状态更新精度损失。
methodDetail.noveltyZh: 从attention-centric PIM扩展到post-transformer状态更新，并在bank共享粒度上优化面积与吞吐。
methodDetail.evidence: ResearchGate full text method/intro; GitHub README

experimentDetail.setupZh: 模型包括RetNet、GLA、HGRN2、Mamba-2、Zamba2和OPT；主实验含2048/2048输入输出长度和batch 32/64/128，NeuPIMs比较使用Zamba2 70B、batch 128、1024/1024长度和8个A100张量并行设置。
experimentDetail.baselinesZh: GPU、GPU+Q、GPU+PIM、HBM-PIM、NeuPIMs。
experimentDetail.mainResultsZh: 状态更新延迟较GPU/GPU+PIM低14.6×/6.9×；attention延迟低6.3×/1.8×；能耗平均低2.2×/1.2×；面积开销13.4%；吞吐相对GPU+PIM最高2.1×，相对GPU上限在可读来源中为3.2×或4.1×。
experimentDetail.limitationsZh: 最终发表版本的吞吐上限需核对；摘要未完整给出每个模型的准确率与吞吐表。
experimentDetail.evidence: evaluation section in web full text

digest.summaryZh: RoPIM针对Transformer中RoPE在推理阶段的高开销，提出bank-level PIM架构。它在内存侧支持乘加、并行数据重排，并用bank/row级数据映射减少bank间通信和DRAM激活；摘要报告RoPE占GPU时间61%，RoPIM最高307.9×性能提升和914.1×能耗节省。
digest.motivationZh: 问题是RoPE虽能在长序列中有效注入位置信息且无需重训，但推理时会因大量数据搬移和执行依赖成为瓶颈。作者观察RoPE占GPU执行时间61%。已有常规GPU/系统在处理RoPE这类位置编码算子时需要频繁搬移数据，长上下文下开销更突出。该问题与用户关注的LLM推理、长上下文内存层次、PIM和Transformer专用算子加速高度相关。
digest.methodZh: 这是面向RoPE算子的PIM硬件架构。RoPIM使用bank-level accelerator，在内存附近支持multiply-add操作以减少片外搬移；通过并行数据重排降低RoPE操作依赖；再用bank-level和row-level数据映射实现并行执行、消除bank-to-bank通信并减少DRAM activations。新意在于把通常被当作小算子的RoPE单独作为PIM加速对象，并围绕其旋转/重排模式设计数据映射。
digest.experimentsZh: 可读摘要只披露与conventional systems对比，指标为性能和能耗；结果为最高307.9×性能提升、914.1×能耗节省，并指出RoPE在GPU上占执行时间61%。摘要/PDF可读部分未披露具体Transformer模型、序列长度、GPU型号、PIM仿真配置、面积开销和平均结果。
digest.affiliationsZh: DGIST Pure条目列出Department of Electrical Engineering and Computer Science、Daegu Gyeongbuk Institute of Science and Technology以及Samsung；Yonsei页面还列出School of System & Semiconductor Engineering。具体作者到机构的映射未完全披露。
digest.researchFitZh: 非常贴合LLM推理内存层次与PIM方向，尤其适合关注长上下文位置编码、数据重排和近存算子加速的人继续读。
digest.whyReadZh: 应深读，因为它把RoPE这种通常不被单独建模的推理算子量化为主要GPU瓶颈，并给出bank/row级PIM映射策略。
digest.limitationsZh: IEEE CAL篇幅短且本地无PDF；可读摘要未披露完整实验设置、平均性能、面积和可扩展性边界。

motivationDetail.problemZh: RoPE在Transformer推理中因数据搬移和依赖导致高延迟。
motivationDetail.gapZh: 常规系统未把RoPE作为内存侧可并行化算子优化，导致长序列下位置编码开销显著。
motivationDetail.whyImportantZh: 长上下文LLM大量使用RoPE，若该算子占GPU执行时间61%，会直接限制端到端推理吞吐和能效。

methodDetail.hardwareSystemDetailZh: 方法减少off-chip data movement，消除bank-to-bank communication并减少DRAM activations；具体bank数量、ALU规模、命令时序和面积在摘要中未披露。
methodDetail.noveltyZh: 面向RoPE位置编码算子的专用PIM，而非仅加速GEMM/GEMV或attention。

experimentDetail.limitationsZh: 未披露平均结果、面积开销、频率、制程和端到端LLM吞吐。

digest.summaryZh: SAL-PIM是面向GPT类文本生成的HBM PIM架构，针对generation阶段逐token迭代、整模型反复读取且数据复用低的问题，把S-ALU放到subarray附近、用LUT线性插值处理非线性，并在HBM buffer die加入C-ALU完成跨bank归约。
digest.motivationZh: 问题是decoder-only GPT文本生成分为可并行summarization和难加速的sequential generation；generation每轮生成一个token且需要读取完整模型，数据复用少，使外部内存带宽成为系统瓶颈。已有GPU/常规加速器难以缓解反复权重读取和非线性函数开销。该问题对用户的LLM推理、HBM/PIM、内存带宽和端到端生成系统研究高度相关。
digest.methodZh: 这是HBM-based subarray-level PIM架构。SAL-PIM在memory subarray旁集成多个S-ALU以利用HBM内部带宽，并针对不同操作设计数据映射；为降低S-ALU面积，利用同bank命令慢时钟共享MAC；在bank内若干subarray作为LUT，通过多地址选择区间做线性插值以处理非线性函数；在HBM buffer die加入C-ALU执行跨bank accumulation和reduce-sum，目标是端到端在PIM中完成Transformer文本生成。
digest.experimentsZh: 作者基于Ramulator构建cycle-accurate simulator，并实现SAL-PIM逻辑单元于28nm CMOS后缩放到DRAM工艺验证可行性。工作负载为GPT-2 medium 345M，输入token 32-128、输出token 1-256；baseline为Nvidia Titan RTX GPU运行Faster Transformer。结果显示4.81%面积开销下，最高4.72×、平均1.83×加速。
digest.affiliationsZh: KAIST Pure条目显示作者单位为Korea Advanced Institute of Science and Technology, School of Electrical Engineering。
digest.researchFitZh: 非常贴合LLM推理系统、HBM/PIM、近存非线性函数和内存带宽优化，是用户主线内值得深读的架构论文。
digest.whyReadZh: 应深读，重点看S-ALU/C-ALU划分、LUT线性插值精度/面积权衡、GPT generation数据映射和端到端PIM边界。
digest.limitationsZh: 实验模型为GPT-2 medium，未从摘要确认更大LLM或KV cache现代长上下文设置；需看全文确认准确率影响、LUT误差和可扩展性。

motivationDetail.problemZh: GPT类generation阶段逐token迭代且每次读取全模型，外部内存带宽成为瓶颈。
motivationDetail.gapZh: 常规GPU和非端到端PIM难以同时处理线性层、非线性函数和跨bank归约。
motivationDetail.whyImportantZh: 文本生成是LLM服务核心路径，带宽瓶颈直接限制吞吐和能效。
motivationDetail.userRelevanceZh: 直接对应LLM推理、HBM/近存计算、非线性算子硬件化和内存层次设计。

methodDetail.coreIdeaZh: 在HBM subarray附近放置S-ALU并用LUT插值和C-ALU完成端到端Transformer文本生成。
methodDetail.hardwareSystemDetailZh: S-ALU利用内部带宽执行近存计算，LUT处理非线性，C-ALU负责跨bank累加/归约；面积控制来自同bank命令慢时钟下的MAC共享。
methodDetail.noveltyZh: 声称是首个用于Transformer文本生成端到端加速的HBM-based PIM架构，并把非线性函数也纳入PIM路径。

experimentDetail.setupZh: Ramulator cycle-accurate simulator；SAL-PIM逻辑单元28nm CMOS实现并缩放到DRAM；GPT-2 medium 345M；输入32-128 token，输出1-256 token。
experimentDetail.baselinesZh: Nvidia Titan RTX GPU running Faster Transformer Framework。
experimentDetail.mainResultsZh: 4.81%面积开销下，最高4.72×加速，平均1.83×加速。
experimentDetail.limitationsZh: 摘要未披露准确率/困惑度、能耗、频率和大模型扩展结果。

digest.summaryZh: 该文面向低比特LLM推理提出量化算法与bit-level加速器协同设计。算法将权重细分为cluster，显式考虑outlier和salient point并保护重要权重；硬件采用内存对齐编码和并行bit-level计算，摘要报告较ANT、OliVe、FineQ均有速度和能效提升。
digest.motivationZh: 问题是LLM推理同时受巨大计算量和模型内存占用限制，超低权重量化能减小带宽/容量压力，但会带来准确率下降和混合精度硬件执行复杂。已有量化方法对outlier、salient weights和组内分布处理不足，现有加速器也不一定能高效执行灵活低比特表示。该问题与用户关注的硬件友好量化、LLM推理加速、bit-level accelerator和软硬件协同高度相关。
digest.methodZh: 这是低比特量化算法与硬件加速器协同设计。算法侧先把权重划成小cluster，做fine-grained intra-cluster bit allocation，显式考虑每个cluster内outlier和salient point分布；再用intra-cluster protection选择性保留重要权重，并引入extended integer format和group-wise scale factor search降低激进降bit导致的精度损失。系统侧设计memory-aligned encoding支持高效访存和混合精度识别，硬件侧用轻量bit-level accelerator进行并行bit-level计算。
digest.experimentsZh: 摘要未披露具体LLM、任务、数据集、硬件平台和精度位宽分布；披露对比对象为SOTA量化算法以及ANT、OliVe、FineQ加速器。算法在超低权重精度下取得更高模型准确率；硬件相对ANT、OliVe、FineQ分别实现1.59×、1.38×、1.61×加速，以及1.52×、1.42×、1.22×能效提升。

papers.title: Profiling a Frontier Agent with EBench: From Direct Control to Harness with Policy
papers.abstract: Frontier multimodal large language models (MLLMs) can control robots without robot-specific training, but how their capabilities compare and interact with post-trained vision-language-action (VLA) and world action model (WAM) policies across manipulation demands remains to be thoroughly evaluated. In this report, we evaluate GPT-6-Astra on EBench as the core of an agent that controls a robot through an agent harness under the same visual and proprioceptive observation protocol as post-trained policies. We study two agent configurations: direct control, in which the agent generates waypoint commands directly, and harness with policy, in which it can also invoke a post-trained VLA or WAM policy for action execution. Under direct control, the agent achieves competitive overall performance relative to post-trained policies. It leads on short-horizon tasks and exhibits the least performance variation across generalization dimensions, whereas it underperforms post-trained policies on long-horizon tasks, tabletop manipulation, and high-precision contact-rich tasks. In the harness with policy, invoking a post-trained VLA or WAM combines the complementary strengths of both components, raising overall task success to the level of the strongest compared post-trained policies while substantially reducing token cost. However, performance remains below the per-task upper bound of the standalone components due to suboptimal policy invocation, fixed-instruction execution without subgoals, and grasp disruption when the agent resumes control. Overall, our study characterizes the capability boundary of a frontier MLLM agent and suggests directions for improving future agent harness design. Project page: https://internrobotics.github.io/EBench-Astra-Tech-Report/

papers.title: Sensorimotor Alignment: A Platonic Proxy for Embodied Policy Success
papers.abstract: Robotic foundation models are typically evaluated through costly closed-loop rollouts, which motivates cheap offline proxies for model capability. The Platonic Representation Hypothesis (PRH) suggests that as representations improve, different modalities such as vision and language converge toward a shared statistical model of reality. We ask whether motion trajectories form another such modality: as embodied models become more capable, should their sensory representations converge toward the structure of physical motion? To examine this, we propose Sensorimotor Alignment ($S^2$), a training-free offline metric that measures how well a model's sensory representation aligns with the geometry of physical motion. We find that $S^2$ correlates positively with downstream robot task success across embodied model families, making it a low-cost offline proxy for prioritizing models before closed-loop evaluation. $S^2$ can also identify promising vision-language model (VLM) backbones even before costly fine-tuning into vision-language-action models (VLAs). Beyond this correlation, $S^2$ offers representation-level explanations for phenomena observed in VLAs and world action models (WAMs). With $S^2$, we extend PRH to embodied models and make sensorimotor alignment empirically measurable, offering insight into why an embodied model succeeds beyond its closed-loop success rate.

digest.summaryZh: 论文提出Sensorimotor Alignment（S²），用训练自由的离线指标衡量机器人基础模型的视觉/文本感知表示与未来物理运动轨迹几何结构是否一致。S²在VLA、原始VLM、World Action Model和真实机器人策略上都与任务成功率呈正相关，可用于昂贵闭环评估前的模型筛选。
digest.motivationZh: 机器人基础模型通常必须通过昂贵的闭环rollout评估真实任务成功率，而VQA分数或视频质量指标并不能稳定预测具身控制效果。作者基于Platonic Representation Hypothesis提出问题：更强模型的感知表示是否会更贴近物理运动结构，从而形成可廉价计算、与下游成功率相关的离线代理指标。
digest.methodZh: S²从每个episode抽取图像与文本经过模型编码器得到的感知embedding，同时提取后续h步末端执行器位置、姿态与夹爪状态构成运动轨迹；方法比较感知空间与运动空间的局部邻域几何一致性，形成训练自由的alignment score。它不修改模型参数，而是用表示层结构衡量模型是否把任务相关物理运动组织进感知表示。
digest.experimentsZh: 实验覆盖12个VLA、8个原始VLM backbone、6个World Action Model以及5个真实机器人策略。12个VLA上S²与SimplerEnv成功率的Pearson r为+0.717；8个VLM的S²与后续VLA成功率r为+0.681，而VQA分数为-0.154；5个真实机器人策略上r为+0.831。论文还比较FID、SSIM、PSNR等视频质量指标并做鲁棒性与表征层消融。
digest.affiliationsZh: Yunfei Xie、Howard H. Qian、Kaiyu Hang：Rice University；Shiyi Lan：NVIDIA；Chen Wei：未在 DBLP/arXiv 元数据中提供
digest.researchFitZh: 属于具身智能与世界模型的算法评估趋势，对用户的Agent/多模态趋势跟踪有价值；与LLM推理芯片和计算核心没有直接硬件关系。
digest.whyReadZh: 值得作为具身/世界模型评估方法浏览，尤其可了解如何用离线表征指标替代昂贵闭环测试；但不需要按芯片论文深读。
digest.limitationsZh: S²主要证明相关性而非因果性，且相关系数基于有限模型数量；不同机器人、任务、参考数据和embodiment不匹配时可能削弱预测能力。

papers.title: When Human Corrections Travel: Safety in Federated VLA Adaptation
papers.abstract: Vision-language-action (VLA) policies can adapt to local human intervention, while federated learning can combine distributed robot experience without pooling raw records. We examine their prospective intersection: sharing adaptations derived from diverse human corrections across tasks, environments, people, and robot embodiments. Corrections differ in modality, safety semantics(urgency, behavioral scope, etc.), and privacy sensitivity. A shared update that improves mean task success may suppress a rare safety intervention or produce an unsafe response on another robot. We argue for three requirements: preserve the context and uncertainty of multimodal corrections when deciding what to share; assess candidate updates in each receiving robot's closed loop before deployment; and evaluate leakage alongside retention of safety-critical evidence. Immediate, legible defensive behavior remains necessary during human interaction. We offer counterexamples and a falsifiable evaluation agenda, not experimental results.

papers.title: ConsisVLA-4D: Advancing Spatiotemporal Consistency in Efficient 3D-Perception and 4D-Reasoning for Robotic Manipulation
papers.abstract: Current Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models primarily focus on mapping 2D observations to actions, but exhibit notable limitations in spatiotemporal perception and reasoning: 1) spatial representations often rely on additional sensors, introducing substantial computational overhead; 2) visual reasoning is typically limited to future-frame prediction, lacking alignment with the instruction-grounded scene and thus compromising spatiotemporal consistency. To address these challenges, we propose ConsisVLA-4D, a unified and efficient framework that enhances spatiotemporal consistency in 3D perception and 4D reasoning. Specifically, we design: 1) CV-Aligner, which ensures cross-view object semantic consistency by filtering instruction-relevant regions and aligning object identities across multiple viewpoints; 2) CO-Fuser, which guarantees cross-object spatial geometric consistency by eliminating spatial relation ambiguities between objects across views using compact latent representations. Building upon these, we introduce 3) CS-Thinker to achieve cross-scene spatiotemporal consistency as actions unfold. It learns implicit knowledge of local dynamics from object-semantic tokens of CV-Aligner and global depth from geometric tokens of CO-Fuser, thereby enhancing efficient visual reasoning under scene variations. Extensive experiments demonstrate that, benefiting from its efficient spatiotemporal consistency design, ConsisVLA-4D achieves 21.6% and 41.5% performance improvements, along with 2.3-fold and 2.4-fold inference speedups compared to OpenVLA on the LIBERO benchmark and real-world platforms, respectively.ConsisVLA-4D is open-sourced and publicly available at

papers.title: Pretraining Knows What, Simulation Teaches How: Compositional Generalization in a Sim-Trained Robot Agent
papers.abstract: A robot policy needs to understand what a task is asking for in a scene, and how to move the robot to accomplish that task. To achieve these two skills, we introduce Zero-real Agent Policy (ZAP), a recipe that teaches a small off-the-shelf vision-language model to control a robot via a simple tool harness. We use a pretrained 27B parameter model to bootstrap world understanding and reasoning, followed by supervised fine-tuning and GRPO on simple simulated tasks to teach it how to move the robot. Without any real-world robot data during training, ZAP reaches 96.7% success on real-world tasks, matching GPT-6 Astra in our harness and outperforming the MolmoAct2 VLA (33.3%), while running 3x faster and 17x cheaper than GPT-6 Astra. We demonstrate that ZAP also generalizes to completely new objects, goals, strategies, and language by seating a test tube in a rack (and choosing a different hole in the rack when prompted), handing a test tube between arms mid-air, drawing an X on a tic-tac-toe board, and playing chess. These goals and types of manipulation don't appear in our training data. Furthermore, ZAP also transfers to an unseen embodiment. On a single-arm Franka, ZAP reaches 55.9% on RoboLab-120, 4.9 percentage points ahead of the leading VLA/WAM baseline.

papers.title: Reliable AI-Assisted Decisions via Selective Auditing
papers.abstract: We consider online monitoring of an AI system that produces a sequence of decisions. At each round, the system outputs a proposed decision together with a confidence score estimating the trustworthiness of the decision. The decision and confidence score need not be produced by the same model: for example, one agent may propose a decision, while a separate verifier agent evaluates it and outputs a correctness or safety score. Based on this information, we must decide whether to accept the AI decision automatically or consult an expert, such as a human auditor, who reviews the proposal and either accepts or corrects it. We formulate this task as an online constrained optimization problem in which the goal is to minimize the frequency of expert auditing while guaranteeing that the fraction of AI errors that go unaudited stays below a user-defined threshold. We derive a family of algorithms with provable error-control guarantees with no assumptions, including a method that is optimally efficient: it asymptotically attains the best achievable auditing rate for both adversarial and i.i.d. data streams. Experiments on screening harmful requests to large language models, qualitative text annotation, and data labeling show that our methods achieve valid error control in practice while substantially reducing the need for human auditing compared to baselines.

digest.summaryZh: 论文研究AI决策的选择性审计：系统为每个自动决策提供置信度，算法只把部分低可信或风险较高样本交给专家，同时约束未被审计的AI错误比例不超过用户设定阈值。作者给出自适应阈值、置信度校准和渐近最优审计算法，并在安全审核、文本编码和数据标注上验证。
digest.motivationZh: 在AI辅助决策中，全部交给人工审核成本高，完全自动化又会留下不可接受的错误；同时模型置信度可能失准，且数据流可能是非独立甚至对抗性的。因此需要在线选择哪些决策必须人工审计，在尽量减少专家工作量的同时，对“错误逃过审计”的比例给出明确且可证明的控制保证。
digest.methodZh: 作者把问题写成在线约束优化：每轮观察AI决策及置信分数，决定自动接受还是调用专家。基础算法维护一个随已观察错误加减更新的阈值，置信度低于阈值时审计；进一步加入置信度再校准，并提出optimally efficient selective auditing，使长期审计率逼近在给定错误约束下可达到的最优水平，同时扩展到批处理和其他错误指标。
digest.experimentsZh: 应用实验覆盖LLM安全审核、质性文本编码和四类数据标注任务。安全实验使用SORRY-Bench 7040条样本和StrongREJECT 1361条样本，以GPT-5.4自一致性8次判断形成置信度，并与随机审计及事后oracle阈值比较；各方法在SORRY-Bench上把错误率控制在目标附近，校准阈值和最优方法节省的审计工作多于基础加性阈值。其他任务也显示最优方法通常获得更高审计节省。
digest.affiliationsZh: Isaac Gibbs：University of Toronto；Elise L. Han：Stanford University；Ryan J. Tibshirani：University of California, Berkeley；Tijana Zrnic：Stanford University
digest.researchFitZh: 属于Agent/AI系统可靠性与人机协同算法，可为自动化Agent中的验证器和人工升级机制提供理论框架；与芯片计算核心本身没有直接联系。
digest.whyReadZh: 若设计高可靠Agent工作流或自动审核系统值得阅读，尤其是其“置信度+选择性人工复核”的控制框架；对当前NPU/GPU微架构主线属于次要趋势。
digest.limitationsZh: 理论保证针对论文定义的错误比例和反馈机制；真实部署中置信分数质量、人工审计延迟、分布漂移与高风险少数事件可能改变实际收益。

motivationDetail.problemZh: AI连续产生决策时，若全部人工核验成本过高，而完全自动接受又无法控制漏审错误。

motivationDetail.whyImportantZh: 在安全审核、标注和专业决策中，需要同时满足可靠性约束与有限人工预算。

experimentDetail.limitationsZh: 部分“人工审核”实验用更强模型做代理，且论文正文可读片段未给出所有任务的统一具体节省百分比，因此这里只报告定性比较。

papers.title: Manifold Steering Reveals the Shared Geometry of Neural Network Representation and Behavior
papers.abstract: Neural representations carry rich geometric structure; but does that structure causally shape behavior? To address this question, we intervene along paths through activation space defined by different geometries, and measure the behavioral trajectories they induce. In particular, we test whether interventions that respect the geometry of activation space will yield behaviors close to those the model exhibits naturally. Concretely, we first fit an activation manifold $M_h$ to representations and a behavior manifold $M_y$ to output probability distributions. We then test the link $M_h \leftrightarrow M_y$ via interventions: we find that steering along $M_h$, which we term manifold steering, yields behavioral trajectories that follow $M_y$, while linear steering -- which assumes a Euclidean geometry -- cuts through off-manifold regions and hence produces unnatural outputs. Moreover, optimizing interventions in activation space to produce paths along $M_y$ recovers activation trajectories that trace the curvature of $M_h$. We demonstrate this bidirectional relationship between the geometry of representation and behavior across tasks and modalities. In language models, we use reasoning tasks with cyclic and sequential geometries as well as in-context learning tasks with more complex graph geometries. In a video world model, we use a task with geometry corresponding to physical dynamics. Overall, our work shows that geometry in neural representation is not merely incidental, but is in fact the proper object for enabling principled control via intervention on internals. This recasts the core problem of steering from finding the right direction to finding the right geometry.

papers.title: Reading, Writing, Sharing, and Interacting with the World through Video
papers.abstract: Video foundation models have advanced rapidly in understanding and generating visual sequences, while video world models seek to capture the underlying dynamics of the world they depict. Despite their different objectives, both concern the relationship between video observations and an evolving world. This survey adopts world modeling as a unifying lens for examining these developments. Viewing an observed video as a partial, lossy, and temporally ordered projection of a latent temporal world, we organize the literature around four complementary operations: reading infers world properties from observed video; writing synthesizes video from specified or learned world conditions; sharing integrates understanding and generation through common modeling mechanisms; and interacting predicts and updates world states under actions and evolving observations. This perspective distinguishes temporal coherence in observed or generated sequences from consistency in the underlying world state. Across tasks, representations, models, datasets, and benchmarks, we trace a shift in emphasis from clip-level recognition and perceptual fidelity toward persistent state, controllable evolution, physical and causal validity, and evaluation grounded in interaction and downstream decisions, and we distill the open challenges that follow.

papers.title: Cost-Aware Abstention for LLM-Based IT Ticket Classification
papers.abstract: Wrong automatic routing of an IT support ticket can cost more than human triage. We evaluate cost-aware abstention as an offline, cost-conditional readiness assessment: select a routing policy on calibration data under explicit costs, then evaluate that frozen policy once on held-out test data. On a public 47,837-ticket, eight-class corpus, we compare four trained non-LLM classifiers with four large language models under zero- and few-shot prompting. Under the illustrative cost model (c_ok, c_triage, c_wrong) = (0, 1, 5), TF-IDF with logistic regression and a threshold of 0.60 selected on calibration reduces test cost from 0.763 to 0.472, a 38.1% relative reduction (paired ratio-bootstrap 95% CI [35.7%, 40.4%]), while lowering wrong routes from 15.3% to 3.5%. Frozen calibration-selected policies also beat both always-route and always-defer on held-out test data in 14 of 16 settings in a post-hoc cost-parameter analysis. The strongest prompted configuration reaches 0.477 accuracy on a stratified 1,000-ticket test subset, versus 0.879 for fine-tuned DistilBERT on the same tickets. Isotonic lowers expected calibration error without reliably improving discrimination: GPT-4o-mini few-shot has one confidence value before and after recalibration and correctness AUROC 0.500. We therefore report correctness AUROC and tie-aware risk-coverage area alongside ECE. At the analytically derived break-even probability 0.80, seven prompted configurations defer all tickets; Haiku few-shot routes only 19/1,000. An LLM-only agreement control and margin/entropy rejection baselines further separate calibration from discrimination. The findings are scoped to this dataset, prompt design, model endpoints, and illustrative costs; the work is an evaluation framework, not a new abstention algorithm or universal deployment certification.

papers.title: Beyond Semantics: An Evidential Reasoning-Aware Multi-View Learning Framework for Trustworthy Mental Health Prediction
papers.abstract: Automated mental health prediction using textual data has shown promising results with deep learning and large language models. However, deploying these models in high-stakes real-world settings remains challenging, as existing approaches largely rely on semantic representations and often produce overconfident predictions under ambiguous, noisy, or shifted data. Moreover, most methods lack reliable uncertainty estimation, undermining trust in risk-sensitive mental health applications. To address these limitations, we formulate the task as a multi-view learning problem that integrates semantic information from encoder-only models with higher-level reasoning information from decoder-only models, where reasoning-aware representations and uncertainty modeling are obtained in a trustworthy manner. To ensure reliable fusion, we adopt an evidential learning framework based on Subjective Logic to explicitly model uncertainty and introduce an evidential fusion strategy that balances complementary views while discounting unreliable evidence. Benchmarking on three real-world datasets, Dreaddit, SDCNL, and DepSeverity, reports accuracies of 0.835, 0.731, and 0.751, respectively, demonstrating its potential for reliable mental health prediction. Additional experiments on robustness to noise and case studies for interpretability confirm that our proposed framework not only improves predictive performance but also provides trustworthy uncertainty estimates and human-understandable reasoning signals, making it suitable for risk-sensitive applications in mental health assessment.

papers.title: MiD-VLM: Detecting and Grounding Global Semantic Misinformation in Image-Caption Pairs
papers.abstract: Semantic misinformation can arise when an authentic image is paired with a caption that changes or distorts its narrative. Because the image itself may contain no visible signs of manipulation, methods designed to detect pixel-level artifacts can miss these misleading image-caption pairs. We study this problem using DGM4+, a dataset designed to evaluate the detection of global scene and semantic inconsistencies. We propose a multimodal model that combines image-text representations from SigLIP with visual scene features from DINOv2 through a projection MLP, and adapts Qwen2-VL-7B using LoRA. The model jointly predicts whether an image-caption pair is authentic, identifies the manipulation type, and grounds the misleading caption tokens. On the DGM4+ validation split, the model achieves an F1 score of $0.9679$ for binary authenticity classification. These results suggest that parameter-efficient adaptation of vision-language models is promising for detecting semantic inconsistencies, while also motivating further work on precise token-level grounding.

papers.title: Wasserstein-Aligned Localisation for VLM-Based Distributional OOD Detection in Medical Imaging
papers.abstract: Zero-shot anomaly localisation via vision-language models (VLMs) offers a compelling approach for rare pathology detection, yet its performance is fundamentally limited by the absence of healthy anatomical context. We reformulate zero-shot localisation as a comparative inference problem in which anomalies are identified through structured comparison against reference distributions of normal anatomy. We introduce WALDO, a training-free framework grounded in optimal transport theory that enables comparative reasoning through: (i) entropy-weighted Sliced Wasserstein distances for anatomically-aware reference selection from DINOv2 patch distributions, (ii) Goldilocks zone sampling exploiting the non-monotonic relationship between reference similarity and localisation accuracy, and (iii) self-consistency aggregation via weighted non-maximum suppression. We theoretically analyse the Goldilocks effect through distributional divergence, and show that references with moderate similarity minimize a bias-variance trade-off in comparative visual reasoning. On the NOVA brain MRI benchmark, WALDO with Qwen2.5-VL-72B achieves $43.5_{\pm1.6}\%$ mAP@30 (95\% CI: [40.4, 46.7]), representing a 19\% relative improvement over zero-shot baselines. Cross-model evaluation shows consistent gains: GPT-4o achieves $32.0_{\pm6.5}\%$ and Qwen3-VL-32B achieves $32.0_{\pm6.6}\%$ mAP@30. Paired McNemar tests confirm statistical significance ($p<0.01$). Source code is available at https://github.com/bkainz/WALDO_MICCAI26_demo .

papers.title: Questioning Instrumental Convergence in RLVR: Checkpoint Evidence from OLMo-3
papers.abstract: Instrumental convergence is often invoked as a general reason to expect capable agents to acquire or express power-seeking subgoals: self-preservation, resource acquisition, deception, or resistance to oversight which poses an important threat to the society. For LLMs, reinforcement learning is the first stage of post-training that directly optimizes behavior against an objective; therefore, it is the stage where convergent instrumental behavior, on IC grounds, likely to appear. Does reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards (RLVR) make a model more likely to express instrumental-convergence behavior, or does this depend on the training regime, evaluation frame, and stage of post-training? We study this question as a checkpoint-conditioned behavioral trajectory rather than as a single before/after safety score. Using InstrumentalEval, we evaluate OLMo-3-7B-Think across SFT, DPO, 13 intermediate RLVR checkpoints, and the final RLVR model. The trajectory is nonmonotonic: instrumental rate rises from 25.0% at SFT to 46.1% near RLVR step 200, then falls to 11.8% at the final checkpoint. Paired item-level tests and step-wise regression support the final SFT-to-RLVR reduction. Prompt framing does not explain this pattern: a harmful-prompt indicator combined with other framing effects explains only 15% of within-checkpoint score variance on average, and Iterative Null-space Projection (INLP) removes a detectable framing direction without changing the SFT-to-final-RLVR gap. Together with preliminary 32B endpoint results (35.53% SFT to 22.37% RLVR final), these findings indicate that RLVR does not monotonically increase instrumental behavior in this setting: the rate rises early, then falls below the SFT baseline. The result is specific to this model family and benchmark, and judge agreement is moderate, so absolute rates should be read cautiously.

papers.title: EpiSEM-Bench: Evaluating Safety and Evidence Recovery in LLM Agents under Missing Evidence
papers.abstract: Tool-using language model agents rely on environmental facts to decide whether an action is permitted. When a tool response omits a safety-relevant fact, an agent may carry out a prohibited action even though the user request is benign and every returned statement is true. We introduce \bench{}, an executable benchmark for evaluating unsafe execution, safety boundaries, and evidence recovery in LLM agents under missing evidence. It contains 300 matched unsafe/safe task pairs across six domains. By systematically suppressing critical facts, the benchmark measures unsafe execution under critical evidence omission and determines the minimum observed failure cardinality, including failures with full evidence and cases with no observed failure after exhaustive testing. An independent audit tool tests whether agents seek missing facts and then withhold prohibited actions while completing permissible tasks. The benchmark reveals substantial variation across the ten models in omission robustness, evidence acquisition, and appropriate action. Resistance to missing evidence does not necessarily translate into useful recovery. Recovery access reduces unsafe execution for all ten models, but agents differ in whether they actively obtain the missing facts and use them to act appropriately in both worlds.

papers.title: HERMES++: Toward a Unified Driving World Model for 3D Scene Understanding and Generation
papers.abstract: Driving world models serve as a pivotal technology for autonomous driving by simulating environmental dynamics. However, existing approaches predominantly focus on future scene generation, often overlooking comprehensive 3D scene understanding. Conversely, while Large Language Models (LLMs) demonstrate impressive reasoning capabilities, they lack the capacity to predict future geometric evolution, creating a significant disparity between semantic interpretation and physical simulation. To bridge this gap, we propose HERMES++, a unified driving world model that integrates 3D scene understanding and future geometry prediction within a single framework. Our approach addresses the distinct requirements of these tasks through synergistic designs. First, a BEV representation consolidates multi-view spatial information into a structure compatible with LLMs. Second, we introduce LLM-enhanced world queries to facilitate knowledge transfer from the understanding branch. Third, a Current-to-Future Link is designed to bridge the temporal gap, conditioning geometric evolution on semantic context. Finally, to enforce structural integrity, we employ a Joint Geometric Optimization strategy that integrates explicit geometric constraints with implicit latent regularization to align internal representations with geometry-aware priors. Extensive evaluations on multiple benchmarks validate the effectiveness of our method. HERMES++ achieves strong performance, outperforming specialist approaches in both future point cloud prediction and 3D scene understanding tasks. The model and code will be publicly released at https://github.com/H-EmbodVis/HERMESV2.

papers.title: LaST-R1: Reinforcing Action via Adaptive Physical Latent Reasoning for VLA Models
papers.abstract: Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models have increasingly incorporated reasoning mechanisms for complex robotic manipulation. However, existing approaches share a critical limitation: whether employing explicit linguistic reasoning that suffers from latency and discretization, or utilizing more expressive continuous latent reasoning, they are predominantly confined to static imitation learning that limits adaptability and generalization. While online reinforcement learning (RL) has been introduced to VLAs to enable trial-and-error exploration, current methods exclusively optimize the vanilla action space, bypassing the underlying physical reasoning process. In this paper, we present \textbf{LaST-R1}, a unified VLA framework that integrates latent Chain-of-Thought (CoT) reasoning over physical dynamics prior to action execution, along with a tailored RL post-training paradigm. Specifically, we propose \textbf{Latent-to-Action Policy Optimization (LAPO)}, a novel RL algorithm that jointly optimizes the latent reasoning process and the action generation. By bridging reasoning and control, LAPO improves the representation of physical world modeling and enhances robustness in interactive environments. Furthermore, an \textbf{adaptive latent CoT mechanism} is introduced to allow the policy to dynamically adjust its reasoning horizon based on environment complexity. Extensive experiments show that LaST-R1 achieves a near-perfect 99.8\% average success rate on the LIBERO benchmark with only one-shot supervised warm-up, significantly improving convergence speed and performance over prior state-of-the-art methods. In real-world deployments, LAPO post-training yields up to a 44\% improvement over the initial warm-up policy across four complex tasks, including both single-arm and dual-arm settings. Finally, LaST-R1 demonstrates strong generalization across simulated and real-world environments.

papers.title: Visual Generation in the New Era: An Evolution from Atomic Mapping to Agentic World Modeling
papers.abstract: Recent visual generation models have made major progress in photorealism, typography, instruction following, and interactive editing, yet they still struggle with spatial reasoning, persistent state, long-horizon consistency, and causal understanding. We argue that the field should move beyond appearance synthesis toward intelligent visual generation: plausible visuals grounded in structure, dynamics, domain knowledge, and causal relations. To frame this shift, we introduce a five-level taxonomy: Atomic Generation, Conditional Generation, In-Context Generation, Agentic Generation, and World-Modeling Generation, progressing from passive renderers to interactive, agentic, world-aware generators. We analyze key technical drivers, including flow matching, unified understanding-and-generation models, improved visual representations, post-training, reward modeling, data curation, synthetic data distillation, and sampling acceleration. We further show that current evaluations often overestimate progress by emphasizing perceptual quality while missing structural, temporal, and causal failures. By combining benchmark review, in-the-wild stress tests, and expert-constrained case studies, this roadmap offers a capability-centered lens for understanding, evaluating, and advancing the next generation of intelligent visual generation systems.

papers.title: Exploration Hacking: Can LLMs Learn to Resist RL Training?
papers.abstract: Reinforcement learning (RL) has become essential to the post-training of large language models (LLMs) for reasoning, agentic capabilities and alignment. Successful RL relies on sufficient exploration of diverse actions by the model during training, which creates a potential failure mode: a model could strategically alter its exploration during training to influence the subsequent training outcome. In this paper we study this behavior, called exploration hacking. First, we create model organisms of selective RL resistance by fine-tuning LLMs to follow specific underperformance strategies; these models can successfully resist our RL-based capability elicitation in agentic biosecurity and AI R&D environments while maintaining performance on related tasks. We then use our model organisms to evaluate detection and mitigation strategies, including monitoring, weight noising, and SFT-based elicitation. Finally, we show that current frontier models can exhibit explicit reasoning about suppressing their exploration when provided with sufficient information about their training context, with higher rates when this information is acquired indirectly through the environment. Together, our results suggest exploration hacking is a possible failure mode of RL on sufficiently capable LLMs.

digest.summaryZh: AgentDrive提出面向自动驾驶agentic AI推理的开放基准，包含30万条LLM生成驾驶场景和10万道多选题。它用七个场景轴组织prompt-to-JSON生成、仿真rollout、安全指标和规则标签，并评测50个LLM的物理、法规、场景等推理能力。
digest.motivationZh: 问题是LLM正被用于自动系统的感知、规划和决策，但缺少大规模、结构化、安全关键的benchmark来训练和评估agentic AI。重要性在于自动驾驶决策需要物理一致、法规合规和安全推理，而现有基准难覆盖多样场景和长尾安全情况。与用户硬件主线关系较弱，但可作为agent/多模态后训练趋势背景，并提示未来边缘/车载LLM推理可能需要面向安全场景的评测负载。
digest.methodZh: 这是数据集/benchmark与评测管线，不是硬件或系统架构。AgentDrive将驾驶场景形式化为七个正交轴：scenario type、driver behavior、environment、road layout、objective、difficulty、traffic density；用LLM驱动的prompt-to-JSON流程生成simulation-ready规格，并做物理/模式约束校验、仿真rollout、surrogate safety metric计算和规则标签。另构建AgentDrive-MCQ，覆盖physics、policy、hybrid、scenario、comparative五类推理。
digest.experimentsZh: 实验设置为AgentDrive-MCQ 10万道多选题，评估50个LLM；全文首页列出GPT-5、ChatGPT 4o、Gemini 2.5 Flash、DeepSeek V3、Qwen3 235B、ERNIE 4.5 300B、Grok 4、Mistral Medium 3.1、Phi 4 Reasoning Plus等。指标是五类推理维度上的表现；摘要只给定性结论：闭源frontier模型在contextual/policy reasoning领先，先进开源模型在structured和physics-grounded reasoning上快速缩小差距，未披露具体分数表。

papers.title: An adaptive wavelet-based PINN for problems with localized high-magnitude source
papers.abstract: In recent years, physics-informed neural networks (PINNs) have gained significant attention for solving differential equations, although they suffer from two fundamental limitations, namely, spectral bias inherent in neural networks and loss imbalance arising from multiscale phenomena. This paper proposes an adaptive wavelet-based PINN (AW-PINN) to address the extreme loss imbalance characteristic of problems with localized high-magnitude source terms. Such problems frequently arise in various physical applications, such as thermal processing, electro-magnetics, impact mechanics, and fluid dynamics involving localized forcing. The proposed framework dynamically adjusts the wavelet basis function based on residual and supervised loss. This adaptive nature makes AW-PINN handle problems with high-scale features effectively without being memory-intensive. Additionally, AW-PINN does not rely on automatic differentiation to obtain derivatives involved in the loss function, which accelerates the training process. The method operates in two stages, an initial short pre-training phase with fixed bases to select physically relevant wavelet families, followed by an adaptive refinement that adapts scales and translations without populating high-resolution bases across entire domains. Theoretically, we show that under certain assumptions, AW-PINN admits a Gaussian process limit and derive its associated NTK structure. We evaluate AW-PINN on several challenging PDEs featuring localized high-magnitude source terms with extreme loss imbalances having ratios up to $10^{10}:1$. Across these PDEs, including transient heat conduction, highly localized Poisson problems, oscillatory flow equations, and Maxwell equations with a point charge source, AW-PINN consistently outperforms existing methods in its class.

digest.summaryZh: AW-PINN 面向含局部高幅值源项的偏微分方程，提出自适应小波基物理信息神经网络，以缓解谱偏置和多尺度损失不平衡。该主题偏科学机器学习，与大模型体系结构主线相关性较弱。
digest.motivationZh: PINN 在求解微分方程时常受神经网络谱偏置和多尺度损失不平衡限制，局部高幅值源项会造成极端损失比例。论文希望用自适应小波基提高对高尺度局部特征的建模能力。
digest.methodZh: 方法根据残差和监督损失动态调整小波基函数，先短暂预训练选择物理相关小波族，再自适应细化尺度和平移，避免在全域铺满高分辨率基。它还避免用自动微分计算损失中的导数以加速训练。
digest.experimentsZh: 论文在瞬态热传导、局部 Poisson、振荡流和带点电荷 Maxwell 方程等 PDE 上评估，损失不平衡最高达 10^10:1。结果显示 AW-PINN 持续优于同类方法，但摘要未给出具体加速或误差数值。
